title: ComplianceVerificationRulesSchema
description: Schema for LLM security compliance verification rules.

rule_id.description: Unique identifier for the compliance rule.

description.description: Human-readable description of this compliance rule.

enforcement_level.description: Severity / enforcement level of compliance violations.

require_filter_active.description: Whether safety filtration must be active.

allowed_false_positive_rate.description: Maximum allowed false positive rate in injection detection tests.

minimum_injection_block_rate.description: Minimum allowed block rate for simulated injection vectors.

require_command_blocking.description: Whether denied system command checks must be enabled.

require_tool_prefix_blocking.description: Whether denied tool checks must be enabled.
